entries.reason: All 189 of the clearing's solids are height-less {x, z, r} footprints and get the collider reader's invented -0.5 to 4 band, so a sightline out here is not evidence about anything: every trunk and fence post reads as a four-and-a-half-metre column. The hip check still runs against these footprints and still means something -- it is what caught SEFF and APE standing inside the treeline. THE CABIN USED TO BE ON THIS LIST AND IS NOT ANY MORE: its furniture now carries authored y0/y1 (see the note on FURNITURE in src/initiation/cabin/site.js), which took the framing gate's cabin findings from six to one and lifted the twin of this entry. The woods are the remaining case, and lifting this one means giving the trees their real trunk heights.
